business_problem: Parameta Solutions had multiple legacy data environments and duplicated effort across businesses, which made it hard to see all available market data, create new value-added services, or deliver secure client access quickly.
solution_summary: Parameta Solutions used Snowflake to collapse a fragmented, acquisition-driven data estate into a single source of truth for market data and client delivery. Archived, structured, and unstructured datasets, including bond transactional data, are loaded into Snowflake so product and engineering teams can run parallel workloads without competing for fixed on-premises resources. The platform lets Parameta join datasets in experimentation or production, discover commercial opportunities, and expose insights its investment-bank and broker clients could not see in their own environments. Snowflake Secure Data Sharing then turns that foundation into direct client feeds, with table-level governance and regional delivery patterns that satisfy security requirements while still accelerating proofs of concept and sales cycles. By centering new tooling and product roadmaps on Snowflake, Parameta improved time to market and strengthened client relationships through faster, adaptable data services.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Unifies Parameta's archived, structured, and unstructured market data so internal teams can analyze and productize it from one platform.

solution_components.name: Snowflake Secure Data Sharing
solution_components.role: Publishes direct client data feeds with governance controls that fit different regional and security requirements.

data_flow: Archived, structured, unstructured, and bond transactional datasets are loaded into Snowflake, where Parameta joins and analyzes them for internal product and engineering use. The curated outputs are then delivered to clients either through direct Snowflake data sharing or extraction processes tailored to each client's preferred access pattern.
business_outcome: Parameta created a single source of truth for client-facing market data, accelerated time to market by 50%, enabled more secure direct client feeds, and gave internal teams the agility to build new commercial services on top of a unified cloud data estate.
architecture_clues: Snowflake holds archived, structured, and unstructured datasets together so teams can experiment and run production analytics from one environment.
Snowflake Secure Data Sharing is combined with table-level governance and region-specific delivery patterns to meet client security requirements.
Parameta supports both direct Snowflake connections and extraction-based delivery for clients that do not want a direct connection.
